role: Orchestrator for Layer 2 perception pipeline: captures frames, runs detection→tracking→feature extraction→persistence check→observation building→spatial extraction in concurrent asyncio tasks.
detail: PerceptionPipeline is the main class that wires all Layer 2 sub-components (frame source, detector, tracker, feature extractors, persistence check, spatial extractor, session manager) into a single runnable unit. It runs two concurrent asyncio tasks: a capture task that pulls frames from the source into a FrameBuffer at capture rate, and a processing loop that pulls the latest frame at processing_fps and runs the full detection→tracking→feature extraction→persistence→observation→spatial extraction chain. Detection and tracking are CPU-bound and dispatched to thread executor. The pipeline maintains change-detection state (MOG2 warm-up for 30 frames, then optional content-hash gating when _change_detection_enabled=True). All Layer 3 communication flows through injected PersistenceCheck and ObservationSessionManager interfaces (CANON A.5 boundary). Observations and spatial relations are validated and collected into instance lists. Exposes run(), stop(), observations property, spatial_relations property, and get_validation_metrics().
gotchas: Change detection infrastructure in place (_change_detection_enabled, _previous_frame_hash, frame_hash MD5) but disabled by default (Phase 1); can be enabled for MOG2-equivalent filtering. Preliminary observations built with debounce_iou_threshold=0.0 for persistence check only, not stored. Spatial extractor receives all tracked objects including TENTATIVE/LOST but filters to CONFIRMED internally; updated feature profiles merged back into full track list for consistency. Debug annotator and frame store are optional and zero-impact when unwired.
